# Entitlement persistence orchestration

[Module map](../README.md) · [Source directory](../../../packages/product-flow-runtime)

Apply validated entitlement events atomically through an injected store and normalize already-authenticated semantic callbacks.

**Scope:** Runtime contract plus in-memory reference adapter; does not verify provider signatures, enable payment rails or create a production database connection.

**Placement:** pnpm workspace member; package `@cambridge-tcg/product-flow-runtime`.

## Progress

Source review recorded **2026-09-28**. Transaction interfaces, orchestration, callback normalizers, reference memory adapter and tests are present. The storefront owns its concrete integration.

This records source and documentation evidence. It does not establish deployment, external access, service health, or passing tests.

**Next review:** Prove adapter transaction and replay behavior before production use. Keep transport authentication and callback mapping in the host.
